title: Short-term reversal in NIFTY 100
hypothesis: The NIFTY 100 stocks with the worst 5- or 21-session returns outperform the universe over the next 5 to 10 sessions by more than the charges of trading them.

mechanism.text: Liquidity provision: price pressure from forced or impatient selling fades.

evidence.finding: Negative first-order serial correlation in monthly returns.

evidence.source: Tripathi and Aggarwal, International Journal of Financial Management
evidence.finding: Intraday reversal within minutes of extreme moves.
527 daily rule trials (RSI(2)-type included) found 0 finalists.

instrument.side: long, or long-short in stock futures

turnover.basis: weekly, about 80% turnover x 0.33% CNC round trip; stock futures long-short about 10%

prior_trials.basis: Discovery's daily rule trials on NIFTY 50 stocks included mean-reversion rules.

holdout_rule.pass_if: Holdout net return after charges above zero and Sharpe above zero.

kill_criteria: Holdout net at or below zero after charges (the expected result).
Gross reversal smaller than twice the round-trip cost in validation.

prior.reason: The effect lives in illiquid small stocks; in NIFTY 100 the weekly drag of 10-14% swamps it.

feasibility.reason: Simple once #71 PIT history and #72 portfolios exist.

contamination: Discovery's 527 daily rule trials and the equity library ran on about 2.3 years of daily bars (2024 to 2026) of NIFTY 50 stocks: single-stock timing rules, not this cross-sectional rule. No cross-sectional portfolio has been run on any part of this span in this repo.
